tasks.title: Round-end sweep keeps blocked tasks' _tests.log
tasks.description:
Goal: sweepRoundTempFiles (src/temp-sweep.ts) must NOT delete `<tempPrefix>task_<id>_tests.log` when task <id> has status 'blocked' in <dataDir>/tasks.json. That log is the only full diagnostic for a block — the round-done verdict flags blocked tasks, yet today the round-end sweep destroys their logs, leaving only the 300-char summarizeFailure note.

Behavior:
- Read <dataDir>/tasks.json once per sweep; collect the set of task ids with status === 'blocked'.
- Skip ONLY the `_tests.log` of those ids. That task's `_prompt.md`, `_review_prompt.md` and notes file (`.ralph_task_<id>_notes.md` / `.cairn_task_<id>_notes.md`) are still swept.
- Non-blocked tasks' `_tests.log` are swept exactly as today — including logs for ids not present in tasks.json at all (archived tasks).
- Best-effort both ways: if tasks.json is missing, unreadable, unparseable, or the wrong shape, KEEP EVERY `_tests.log` (status unknown => keep diagnostics), still sweep everything else. The sweep must never throw and never change a caller's verdict or exit code.
- Do NOT use readTasksFile() from src/tasks-file.ts — it can repair / restore from snapshot / write. Use a plain read + JSON.parse, tolerant of any error.
- The read must go through an injectable dep: add e.g. `readFileSync: (p: string, enc: 'utf-8') => string` to SweepRoundTempFilesDeps, with fs.readFileSync in defaultSweepDeps(). A kept log is removed at the first round end after the task stops being blocked, or overwritten by validation if the task re-runs first.

Call sites:
- `cairn run`'s loop exit (src/commands/run.ts ~line 789) builds the deps from RunDeps. RunDeps has no readFileSync today — add one (default fs.readFileSync) and pass it through (or otherwise pass a reader), so the mocked-fs run tests control what the sweep sees. If the sweep silently used the real fs against a fake dataDir, existing run tests expecting `_tests.log` to be swept would hit the 'unreadable -> keep all' branch and fail.
- `cairn round next`'s round-done branch (src/commands/round.ts ~line 123) calls sweepRoundTempFiles(dataDir) with default deps — fine as-is unless you choose to pass something.

Tests (both test/commands/round.test.ts for the round-done branch and test/commands/run.test.ts for the loop-exit sweep):
(a) a blocked task's `_tests.log` survives while its `_prompt.md`, `_review_prompt.md` and notes file are removed;
(b) a non-blocked (pending/in-progress or absent-from-tasks.json) task's `_tests.log` is removed;
(c) with tasks.json unreadable/unparseable, every `_tests.log` survives, other scratch is still removed, and no error propagates (round: verdict/exit code unchanged);
(d) existing never-sweep tests still pass.

Update the temp-sweep.ts module docblock and sweepRoundTempFiles' comment to describe the blocked-log exception and the keep-all-on-unreadable rule. Do not touch CLAUDE.md (the docs task handles it).

CONSTRAINTS (self-modifying round, binary pinned): do NOT modify cairn.json (including its healthCheck and its narration block — the user removes that by hand after the round), install.sh, or package.json's build script. Never run `cairn round`, `cairn hook`, `cairn init` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init`) against the project root — temp dirs only. Do not run ./install.sh. Use TDD: write/adjust the failing test first, see it fail, then make it pass. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` must be green at the end.
tasks.notes:
Round-end sweep now keeps a blocked task's `<tempPrefix>task_<id>_tests.log`.

TDD: failing first run `bun test test/commands/run.test.ts test/commands/round.test.ts` showed e.g.
`(fail) roundNext > round-done > keeps a blocked task's _tests.log but sweeps its other scratch` and
`(fail) runRun > cleanup keeps a blocked task's _tests.log but sweeps its prompt, review-prompt and notes` (plus the unreadable/unparseable/wrong-shape cases). After the fix: typecheck clean, `bun test` 1243 pass / 0 fail.

Changes:
- src/temp-sweep.ts: SweepRoundTempFilesDeps gains `readFileSync(p, 'utf-8')`; `defaultSweepDeps()` now exported. New `blockedTaskIds()` does a plain read + JSON.parse of <dataDir>/tasks.json (not readTasksFile) and returns the blocked id set, or 'all' on any error / non-array `tasks` (keep every _tests.log). Read lazily, once per sweep, only if a _tests.log candidate exists. Only `_tests.log` is spared; prompt/review_prompt/notes of the blocked task still swept. Docblocks updated.
- src/commands/run.ts: RunRunDeps.readFileSync (default fs.readFileSync) passed into the loop-exit sweep. makeRunDeps in run.test.ts defaults it to `{"tasks":[]}` so existing sweep tests keep sweeping logs.
- src/commands/round.ts: RoundNextDeps.sweepReadFileSync (optional) overrides the sweep's reader — needed because roundNext itself must read tasks.json successfully to reach round-done, so the "unreadable at sweep time" case can only be tested via injection.
- Tests: run.test.ts (blocked kept; pending/in-progress/absent swept; unreadable/unparseable/wrong-shape keep all logs), round.test.ts (blocked kept; pending/absent swept; unreadable via roundNextCommand exit 0 + verdict unchanged; unparseable). Note: round-done can't coexist with an in-progress task (always selectable), so the in-progress case lives in run.test.ts only.

Observation: 6 narration tests in run.test.ts fail when run.test.ts is run in isolation (pre-existing, also on HEAD without my changes); they pass in the full `bun test` run — order/env dependent, not touched here.
CLAUDE.md not updated (docs task handles it).

tasks.title: Strip narration and ntfy from the run loop and the stream filter
Delete the narration modules, lib/, and the cairn narrate command
tasks.description:

src/index.ts:
- remove `import { runNarrate } from './commands/narrate'` and the `narrate <action>` command registration (~lines 176-183);
- in the preAction/setup block (~lines 38-47) remove `const libDir = join(cairnRoot, 'lib')`, `process.env.CAIRN_LIB_DIR = libDir` and `process.env.CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON = ...`. Repo-root .gitignore: remove the `lib/__pycache__/` line. KEEP the `.venv/` line.

Leave alone: src/process.ts (ProcessManager is generic) and test/process.test.ts ('narrate' there is only a sample name); BRAND.socket / BRAND.pidFile in src/brand.ts and config.narration in config.ts/types.ts (the next task removes those); src/commands/init.ts's narration hook scripts (the next task); docs (the last task).

tasks.title: Remove narration from config, types, init and BRAND
tasks.description:
Round 19 removes narration and ntfy. The consumers (run.ts, stream-filter.ts — task #139) and the modules (narration.ts, commands/narrate.ts, lib/ — task #140) are already gone. This task removes the config, types, init prompts/hook scripts, and BRAND constants.

Remove:
- src/types.ts: the `narration` field from CairnConfig and its checks in isCairnConfig (~lines 57-61). isCairnConfig must no longer require `narration`.
- src/config.ts: narrationRaw parsing and the narration defaults in loadConfig (~28-29, 50-54); the CAIRN_NARRATION_ENABLED / CAIRN_NARRATION_VOICE / CAIRN_NTFY_TOPIC env exports (~151-153).
- src/commands/init.ts: the narrationEnabled / narrationVoice / ntfyTopic fields of the config-prompt type (~69-71) and their defaults (~209-211); the TTS / voice / ntfy prompts (~257-263); the `narration` key in the generated cairn.json (~276); NARRATE_SH, SPEAK_SH, NOTIFY_SH (from ~416), NARRATION_HOOKS, writeNarrationHooks, installNarrationHooks, and the installNarrationHooks call in the init flow (~819); any imports that become unused.
- src/brand.ts: BRAND.socket and BRAND.pidFile. Rewrite the STANDING RULE comment (~lines 6-10) to name only dataDir / configFile with findDataDir() / findConfigFile() — drop socket/pidFile and findNarrationSocketPath / findNarrationPidFile.
- Delete this repo's tracked .claude/hooks/narrate.sh, speak.sh and notify.sh (git rm). If .claude/hooks/ is then empty it simply disappears. Do NOT add any init migration that deletes such scripts in other projects — they exit 0 when the socket is missing and are inert (deliberate decision).

Old configs must keep loading: a cairn.json that still has a `narration` block (this repo's does until the user removes it by hand after the round) must load without error or warning; the loader simply ignores the key.

Required tests (TDD — write first):
(1) test/config.test.ts: loadConfig on a cairn.json containing `"narration": {"enabled": false, "voice": "bf_emma", "ntfyTopic": "x"}` succeeds, emits no warning (spy on console.warn / stderr as the suite does elsewhere), and the result has no `narration` property;
(2) test/types.test.ts: isCairnConfig accepts a config object with no `narration` key;
(3) test/commands/init.test.ts: init's generated cairn.json has no `narration` key, and init prompts no longer ask about TTS/voice/ntfy.
Also update/remove existing tests asserting narration defaults, NARRATION_HOOKS, writeNarrationHooks / installNarrationHooks, the CAIRN_NARRATION_* / CAIRN_NTFY_TOPIC env vars, or BRAND.socket/pidFile (check test/brand.test.ts).

Afterward: `grep -rn -i 'narrat\|ntfy\|BRAND.socket\|pidFile' src test` returns nothing except test/process.test.ts's sample process name 'narrate', which stays.

CONSTRAINTS (self-modifying round, binary pinned): do NOT modify cairn.json (including its healthCheck and its narration block — the user removes that by hand after the round), install.sh, or package.json's build script. Never run `cairn round`, `cairn hook`, `cairn init` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init`) against the project root — temp dirs only. Do not run ./install.sh. Use TDD: write/adjust the failing test first, see it fail, then make it pass. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` must be green at the end.
